rationale: Fitch RACs are the only per-entity analytical text on foreign-owned HU bank subsidiaries, but the site requires free registration/login for full commentaries.
ESMA European Rating Platform is a free, regulator-run, daily-updated rating database - the legally clean spine for all HU bank rating actions.
Bulk filed-accounts licensing offer: a one-off procurement/licensing route to the e-beszamolo corpus, needs a human to clear terms and fees.
Audit oversight authority reports are a secondary quality signal on bank audit opinions; URL failed and the site was reorganised, re-resolve before approving.
MKVK auditor register is mined once to enumerate which firms audit HU credit/payment institutions and where their transparency reports sit.
Single methodology article on parsing Hungarian credit-institution accounts - useful reference artifact, not a recurring signal producer.
Deloitte HU banking hub carries the recurring CE Banking Outlook and 'Bank ma' studies with per-bank data and disclosed methodology.
KPMG HU studies hub hosts recurring primary bank-executive surveys (lending sentiment index, Banking CEO Outlook); failed fetch is a soft signal only.
KPMG HU blog is a separate low-latency feed that flags new surveys earlier and less gated than the formal study PDFs.
PwC HU finance-sector hub runs the recurring finance-leader survey and Digitalis Penzugyi Korkep on payment behaviour - banking and payments both in scope.
vg.hu business press is a live redundancy feed restating rating actions in Hungarian when Portfolio is paywalled.
Erste Group parent ratings page is the standalone disclosure route for a HU subsidiary that publishes nothing itself; siblings are other IR sections, this one is the ratings feed.
S&P Global Market Intelligence has valuable ranked European bank comparisons but most content sits behind subscription; access must be cleared.
Third-party aggregator mined once as a seed entity list of HU banks and who rates them; low credibility for ongoing monitoring.
BBJ ratings vertical is a dedicated English-language feed indexing HU sovereign and bank rating events.
OTP IR analyst/consensus page is issuer-maintained, enumerable, and yields dated consensus files back to 2023 - top-value A1 disclosure source.
Concorde is the reference domestic sell-side house on HU banks, but published research is largely client-only; confirm what is free-to-web before approving.
Erste Market analyses portal publishes largely free company and macro notes covering HU banks - a durable recurring research feed.
Recommendation track-record table is a sub-page of the erstemarket.hu analyses portal already monitored; valuable but not standalone.
OTP Global Markets research feed is a distinct free-to-web publication stream; note the conflict when it covers peer banks.
OTP Analysis Centre adds macro forecasts plus a weekly event calendar that acts as scheduling backbone for disclosure flow.
A single year's issuer-forum event page under bet.hu; monitor the exchange events/press section rather than this dated sub-page.
Xmatch is an about-page for a partly closed matchmaking platform under bet.hu; early-signal value unproven and the matching venue itself is not public.
BET press release archive is the paginated primary feed announcing listings, admissions and investor events - the durable bet.hu entry point.
E-Akademia slide archive is a bet.hu sub-section; retrievable decks are useful evidence but covered by monitoring the exchange parent.
BET YouTube channel plausibly hosts event webcasts, but the recorded URL is a consent-redirect and the handle is unverified - resolve the real channel first.
Equilor publishes free news/analysis and formal MBH coverage with target prices - a named, trackable HU sell-side actor.
MBH IR page carries quarterly flash reports and investor-day decks for Hungary's second listed bank - core A1 disclosure source.
